text:
marta_sales: FYI Acme POC demo today - they hit a hard error when requesting embeddings from eu-west. Customer is also asking for a short Dedicated trial quote + KMS/HSM details. Can we swarm?

alex_lee: ack. what error are they seeing exactly?

marta_sales: pasted from them: ```error: model "redwood-embed-legacy" not available in region eu-west-1
request_id=cli-9f23
status=404```

samir_eng: 404 with that message = model variant was removed from eu-west catalog. Possibly deprecation. Which SDK call are they using?

marta_sales: embeddings.create via our JS SDK, version 2.3. They said they pinned model name in config.

lina_devex: quick workaround: if they update to `redwood-embed-v2` or remove explicit region pinning it should route to compatible variant. But need to confirm embedding vector shape/backwards compat.

samir_eng: confirm: v2 has same dims and is compatible for typical semantic search, but there are tokenization differences for rare edge cases. We should warn them but it's safe for demo.

marta_sales: customer wants an official statement — they need to know if switching model breaks their tests. Also asked about extending trial credits if we need to re-run tests.

ben_oncall: re: rate limits - they also reported intermittent 429s when spamming batch embed requests (50 concurrent). Logs show bursts causing throttling: ```429: rate_limited - buckets: customer-987, route: /v1/embeddings create```

samir_eng: batching policy suggestion: reduce concurrency to 8-12 and use our SDK batch helper. We can also enable short-term burst allowance for trials; requires ops approval.

lina_devex: I'll draft a quick script for them to convert pins: ```const client = new Redwood(); const embeddings = await client.embeddings.create({model: 'redwood-embed-v2', input});``` add note about parity.

marta_sales: security questions: Acme asked if KMS key import required for Private trial and whether HSM-backed keys are possible. They also asked about TLS termination in our dedicated offering.

security-bot: quick answers from docs: KMS integrations supported (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). HSM direct-peering is available on Private via the enterprise package. TLS terminates at customer VPC edge for Private; for Dedicated we terminate in our infra but with mutual TLS option. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/kms-hsm

alex_lee: can we commit to a short Dedicated trial for them (2 weeks) to validate throughput? They'll pay for minimal reserved capacity but want credits applied. Pricing folks — need a quote addendum.

marta_sales: they asked for committed tps numbers: 250 reqs/min embeddings + occasional 1k/min chat peaks.

samir_eng: 250/min embeddings is modest; recommend 1 GPU with autoscale burst policy to cover 1k chat peaks. For quantization/throughput we'll recommend int8 model profile. I'll open an infra ticket to reserve a test node.

deploy-bot: ticket #INF-4521 created by samir_eng: reserve eu-west test GPU node; tags: sales-poc, acme, trial.

ben_oncall: I'll temporarily lift the soft rate cap for customer-987 for 48 hours once ticket confirms node ready. Monitor for errors.

marta_sales: perfect — actions: (1) lina send pin-to-v2 migration snippet + warning, (2) samir open infra ticket (done), (3) ben lift cap when node ready, (4) alex coordinate pricing quote with finance. I'll tell Acme we can extend trial credits for migration work. :thumbsup:

lina_devex: sending snippet + sample test harness now.

samir_eng: note to self: follow up on catalog deprecation notice; we should add auto-notifications to customers pinning deprecated model names. filing follow-up.

marta_sales: thanks everyone. I'll update Acme after Lina's snippet and confirm trial credit extension.

alex_lee: once we confirm, I'll add the Dedicated trial addendum to the quote and loop finance.

marta_sales: end of thread — we'll close after infra node is ready and customer verifies embeddings with `redwood-embed-v2`.
